summary: Implemented three feature requests mined from a personal brainstorm file: Secrets Manager UI, GitHub as a second OAuth provider, and live health-check run/stop in generated FinalApps. Research repeatedly found the premise stale -- OAuth and the keyring secret store already existed (built prior session, undocumented in README/UI), so real new work was: a Secrets tab wired to the existing store, an idp-github adapter + generalized multi-provider OAuthGoogleController + login page, and (after flagging and getting explicit sign-off to lift) a deliberate, narrow reversal of the S5.3 read-only-verification-page security boundary -- ControlPanelHealthController runs exactly 3 individually-source-read, verified-safe _ops scripts (Status-App/Status-Environment/Check-Provenance) behind SUPERUSER auth, a hardcoded allowlist, and a timeout; two scripts that looked safe by name were excluded after reading their actual bodies (one leaks the DB password, two write real DB rows every run). Manager bumped 0.4.1 -> 0.4.2.
